mapper.select: select st.id, st.name, st.student_no, st.classgroup_id, cg.name as classgroup_name, s.id as speciality_id, s.name as speciality_name, c.id as college_id, c.name as college_name from student st join classgroup cg on cg.id = st.classgroup_id join speciality s on s.id = cg.speciality_id join college c on c.id = s.college_id where st.id = #{id}

select st.id, st.name, st.student_no, st.classgroup_id, cg.name as classgroup_name, s.id as speciality_id, s.name as speciality_name, c.id as college_id, c.name as college_name from student st join classgroup cg on cg.id = st.classgroup_id join speciality s on s.id = cg.speciality_id join college c on c.id = s.college_id order by st.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into student(name, student_no, classgroup_id) values(#{name}, #{studentNo}, #{classgroupId})
